subject: Re: ZenMed discovery — proposal for 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah@zenmed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ZenMed discovery — proposal for 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive

Hi Hannah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed next step:

Recap (from our call)
- Primary goal: move a PoC of inference for triage models to production with predictable latency under 100ms p50 and cost targets in mind.
- Constraints: PHI data, vendor procurement window in Q3, and internal infra team availability only during PST mornings.
- Success criteria you called out: latency target, identical behavior to your current on-prem model, and an audit trail for model versions.

Proposed next step
- A 60–90 minute hands-on technical deep dive involving your ML and infra leads + our Solutions Engineer (Ben) to:
  1) Review current model architecture and serving constraints
  2) Walk through Redwood Dedicated/Private options and data egress/security setups
  3) Pilot scope and acceptance criteria for a 6–8 week PoC

Suggested agenda (we can tweak)
1) 5m quick re-intro and scope framing (Grace)
2) 25–35m architecture review + bottlenecks (ZenMed leads)
3) 25–30m Redwood runtime + security controls demo (Ben)
4) 10–20m PoC scope, roles, next steps, procurement questions (Grace & Lauren)

Availability: Ben and I have the following morning slots (PST) next week: Tue 7/3 9:00–11:00, Wed 7/4 8:30–10:30, Thu 7/5 9:30–11:30. If none work, happy to coordinate a Doodle poll.

I attached a rough SOW draft (v1) to help frame the PoC discussion — it is intentionally lightweight.

Would love to lock a time and confirm who from your infra/ML teams will attend so Ben can prepare runbook examples.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: zenmed-sow-draft-v1.pdf

Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 15:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZenMed discovery — proposal for 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive

Thanks Grace — really helpful recap. Zach (our infra lead) and I reviewed your agenda and it looks good. A couple quick notes:

- Attendees: Hannah Li (Head of ML), Zach Morgan (Infra/Platform), Dr. Mira Patel (Lead Data Scientist) — Mira will likely join for the architecture portion but may drop after the serving demo.
- Must-haves for the session: concrete examples for handling PHI in private deployments and a comparison of Dedicated vs Private (networking + cost).

For times, PST mornings are ideal. Of your suggested slots, Tue 7/3 9:00–10:30 PST works best for us. If we need the full 90m, we can extend to 11:00 — please confirm.

Finally, can Ben include a short checklist of what logs/audit artifacts Redwood can expose? That will help our security review.

Appreciate the SOW draft — we'll take a look and give feedback before the call.

—Hannah
Hannah Li
Head of ML | ZenMed AI
hannah@zenmed.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZenMed discovery — proposal for 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive

Hi Hannah — great to e-meet. I can cover the runtime demo and security telemetry. Quick prep notes so I tailor content:

1) Which model frameworks are you running (TorchScript, ONNX, TensorFlow SavedModel)? If you can flag the main serving artifact and typical sequence length, that helps.
2) For PHI handling, do you have a specific KMS (AWS KMS or on-prem HSM) preference?
3) Audit/log ask — I’ll bring examples of: request/response trace IDs, per-token latency breakdown, per-request policy evaluation logs, and model-versioning audit lines. If you need ISO-style reports or SOC-like artifacts from our side, let me know and I can surface relevant docs.

I’m blocking Tue 7/3 8:45–11:30 PST for prep and the call.

—Ben

Thanks all — calendar invite coming in a minute. Looking forward to the technical session.
